name: Prominent Chest & Belly Side Profile
summary: Fuller forward protrusion along both upper and mid-torso profile.
style_goal: Elongate the front vertical line, streamline side depth, and create clean tailored structure.

tops.reason: Drapes uninterrupted over chest and belly.

dresses.reason: Hangs freely from shoulders without midsection waist pinch.

reasoning.overall: Vertical lines, open jackets, and shift cuts streamline forward torso volume.

styling_tips: Wear dark inner layers with contrasting open outer jackets to create slimming vertical side columns.
Avoid tight necklines and bulky chest pockets.
